title: DogTag RecordArtifact v1
description: Selective disclosure by obfuscation over a record's own opened-leaf tree, with NO reserved owner-control leaves (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16) - the sibling wire format of dogtag.redacted-tag-artifact.v1.schema.json, which describes the PROFILE-tree variant instead. NOT a W3C VC credential and NOT composed with dogtag.envelope.v1: a RecordArtifact is an opened-leaf custody/export wire record, like its RedactedTagArtifact sibling. Shape only - this schema says nothing about whether `root` actually recomputes from `disclosed`+`obfuscatedLeafHashes`, whether the seven non-maskable keyPaths (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16) are actually present in `disclosed`, or whether `reservedLeafHashes` is actually empty; those are verifyRecordArtifact's job (packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/recordArtifact.ts, crates/dogtag-standard-rs/src/record_artifact.rs). Deliberately carries NO top-level dogTagIdField/dogTagIdDec/issuerClone/recordType fields, unlike its RedactedTagArtifact sibling: credentialSubject.dogTagId, issuer.contract, and recordType are each non-maskable DISCLOSED LEAVES on every valid RecordArtifact, so a second, unchecked top-level copy of any of them would only invite drift between what is shown and what the root commits to (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16's wire-format note) - a caller reads these values out of `disclosed` once verifyRecordArtifact has accepted the artifact.

protocolVersion.description: e.g. "dogtag-v2/1" (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 12) - which fixed encoding-and-hashing manner this artifact's leaves were committed under.

artifactType.description: Wire-format discriminator (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16): distinguishes this shape from a RedactedTagArtifact (dogtag.redacted-tag-artifact.v1, which carries no artifactType field of its own - its absence is read as the implicit "tag" case). Not a leaf; not itself cryptographically checked.

schemaId.description: Optional: the registry $id of the record type this credential was issued/received against, e.g. https://dogtag.io/schemas/vaccination/v1. Absent on a legacy/backfilled artifact whose original issuance predates schemaId stamping - the leaf-commitment root recompute never depends on it. Mirrors the disclosed credentialSchema.id leaf for convenience only; a caller that needs the authoritative value reads the leaf itself.

root.description: The record tree's Merkle root (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 7), folded over disclosed + obfuscated leaf hashes ONLY - reservedLeafHashes contributes nothing (it is always empty for a record artifact).

disclosed.description: Fully opened attribute leaves - the OpenedLeaf shape (packages/dogtag-standard-ts/src/profileBind.ts). MUST include an opening for every one of the seven non-maskable keyPaths (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16) for the artifact to verify, though this schema does not and cannot express that cross-cutting rule structurally - see verifyRecordArtifact. No maxItems: unlike a RedactedTagArtifact, a RecordArtifact is never consent-bound, so section 10's 64-leaf cap does not apply (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16).

obfuscatedLeafHashes.description: Attribute leaves named ONLY by their opaque hash - masked BY CHOICE. Disjoint in principle from disclosed; verifyRecordArtifact rejects any overlap at the leaf-commitment layer. MUST NOT contain the hash of a non-maskable leaf while that leaf is simultaneously absent from disclosed (verifyRecordArtifact's non-maskable-set check).

reservedLeafHashes.description: MUST be empty on every RecordArtifact (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 16) - contra its RedactedTagArtifact sibling, which requires exactly 3. A record's tree never had a reserved owner-control leaf to begin with: issueRecord(recordType, root) anchors the root directly, with no owner-control material folded in. Present (as an always-empty array) rather than omitted so the two sibling wire shapes stay structurally parallel.

hex32.description: A 32-byte big-endian field element, 0x-prefixed lowercase-or-uppercase hex (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 5). Shape only: a value in this exact pattern can still exceed the BN254 scalar field modulus, which only the leaf-commitment-layer parser (fromHex32/from_hex32) rejects.

openedLeaf.description: keyPath/saltHex/tag/value - the packed wire form specs/leaf-commitment.md section 4 describes, split into named fields.

saltHex.description: 16 raw bytes, hex-encoded. The 0x prefix is optional here (hexToBytes/hex::decode strip it when present) - this schema is deliberately no stricter than the code it mirrors.

tag.description: TypeTag (specs/leaf-commitment.md section 1's table): 0 Null, 1 Bool, 2 String, 3 Integer, 4 Decimal, 5 Bytes.

value.description: The packed wire value (section 4): the canonical string form for every tag except Bytes, whose value is lowercase hex with no 0x prefix; Null's value is the empty string.
